title: rsa_key_import: FIPS size check propagates -EIO not -EINVAL
description: In wolfssl_rsa_key_import, when the decoded key is smaller than RSA_MIN_KEY_BYTES (256), code sets ret=-EINVAL then jumps to err_free_key. The shared error tail calls wolfssl_rsa_xlat_err(ret). wolfssl_rsa_xlat_err(-22) has no matching case so the default fires: logs 'unhandled wc_err=-22' and returns -EIO. Caller receives -EIO instead of -EINVAL for a too-small key. Impact: callers cannot distinguish bad key from IO error. Fix: return -EINVAL directly before goto, or add a kernel-errno passthrough in xlat_err for negative values that don't match wolfCrypt codes.
